mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users ( USER_ID, USER_PWD, EMAIL, USER_NAME, PHONE, USER_ADDR, FULL_ADDR, ZIPCODE, ROLE, SOCIALTYPE, CDATE ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{pwd}, #{email}, #{userName}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{detailAddress}, #{postcode}, 'USER', 'LOCAL', NOW() )
INSERT INTO users ( USER_ID, USER_PWD, USER_NAME, ROLE, SOCIALTYPE, BIZ_STATUS, CDATE ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{pwd}, #{userName}, 'BIZ', 'LOCAL', 'PENDING', NOW() )
INSERT INTO biz_info ( USER_ID, BIZ_NAME, BIZ_NO, BIZ_FILE_NAME, BIZ_FILE_PATH, REG_DATE ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{bizName}, #{bizNo}, #{bizFileName}, #{bizFilePath}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT USER_ID AS userId, USER_PWD AS pwd, USER_NAME AS userName, ROLE AS role, EMAIL AS email, PHONE AS phone, BIZ_STATUS AS bizStatus FROM users WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
SELECT USER_ID AS userId, USER_NAME AS userName, PHONE AS phone FROM users WHERE USER_NAME = #{userName} AND PHONE = #{phone}
